name: Qingdao Gon Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Qingdao Gon Technology Co., Ltd. is engaged in the full spectrum of activities, from researching and developing to manufacturing and distributing specialized chemical compounds and collagen-derived items. The company's core expertise lies in altering organic polymers, creating advanced organic polymer composites, and producing synthetic turf. Its extensive product range features eco-friendly petrochemicals, modified organic polymers, sophisticated polymer composites, biodegradable substances, photochemical products, materials designed for sports and health, and lightweight structural parts for new energy vehicles. Additionally, the firm supplies the healthcare industry with gelatin, plasma expander gelatin, natural collagen, empty pharmaceutical capsules, a distinctive dual-protein dietary fiber blend, and various cosmetic formulations. Established in 2000, Qingdao Gon Technology Co., Ltd. maintains its primary operations in Qingdao, China.
